supersedes: The earlier direct-credential run verified functionality only and did not satisfy the credential boundary. These are new Cloud boxes created with native Secrets.

credential_boundary.real_key_used_only_at: authorized model provider API through host-scoped proxy substitution
credential_boundary.local_service_credentials: Hermes caller key and LiteLLM loopback key are separate from the model-provider credential.

optional_lifecycle.only_wake_trigger: external HTTPS request to native Gateway

validation_scope.credential_scan: Relevant guest configuration, workspace/data files, logs, session state, and readable process environments. Both agent-user and guest-root access were exercised; per-agent evidence lists unreadable/disappeared entries and oversized files. This is not an exhaustive memory or disk forensic proof.
validation_scope.scan_transport: Collected data was compared to the real provider key only on the workstation. The real key was not passed into a guest scan command. Protected temporary audit files were removed.
validation_scope.tls: Verification remained enabled. Python and Node clients trusted the guest system bundle containing the BoxLite proxy CA.
validation_scope.bridge: Claude and Codex use BoxOptions.entrypoint/cmd for the loopback bridge. Both were verified as the box main process, restarted, and then completed a fresh real tool task.
validation_scope.lifecycle: Optional. CLI boxes used auto_stop=0; the Hermes lifecycle check changed the documented auto_stop to 120.

failures_resolved: The original direct-provider-key configurations were replaced with native host-scoped Secrets.
A Pi task phrased as a terminal command stalled. The final documented file-write task passed with real tools and independent verification.

Detached exec bridges were reaped, and a foreground experiment showed idle WebSocket failures. Both approaches were removed. The final bridge is the native box main process and was revalidated after restart.
Temporary local transport failures were distinguished from task results before repeating idempotent work.
Large/short exec audit output was unreliable, so checks used protected compressed file transfers with integrity validation.
transport_note: Local DNS/TLS routing required a localhost forwarding transport to api.boxlite.ai with upstream TLS verification. No system network configuration was changed.
documentation_validation: Desktop and 390px mobile review; no page-wide horizontal overflow
